title: Configure and troubleshoot a Bedrock guardrail
description: Practice durable Bedrock console intent in an AWS-familiar semantic simulator.

services.name: Amazon Bedrock
services.description: Build and govern generative AI applications.

operations.label: Create guardrail
operations.description: Create a versioned semantic guardrail resource.

operations.label: Configure guardrail
operations.description: Apply strict filtering and blocked output behavior.

operations.label: Troubleshoot invocation
operations.description: Repair an invocation that is not using the guardrail.

checkpoints.title: Create a guardrail
checkpoints.objective: Create a Bedrock guardrail named safe-output.
checkpoints.instruction: Open Guardrails and create safe-output with standard filtering.
checkpoints.rationale: A named guardrail creates an independently governed safety resource.
checkpoints.expectedOutcome: safe-output appears as an active guardrail.
hints: Choose standard filtering for the initial policy.

checkpoints.title: Configure strict output safety
checkpoints.objective: Set strict filtering and block unsafe output.
checkpoints.instruction: Edit safe-output, select strict filtering, and enable blocked output behavior.
checkpoints.rationale: The resource must enforce the intended safety outcome, not merely exist.
checkpoints.expectedOutcome: safe-output reports strict policy and output blocking on.
hints: Both policy and blocked response behavior need changes.

checkpoints.title: Inspect observable state
checkpoints.objective: Verify the guardrail configuration from resource details.
checkpoints.intent: Confirm deployment state without relying on a click path.
checkpoints.instruction: Inspect safe-output details and confirm its active strict configuration.
checkpoints.rationale: Operations should verify observable state rather than assume a save succeeded.
checkpoints.expectedOutcome: An inspection event confirms the active strict guardrail.
hints: Use resource details, not edit controls.

checkpoints.title: Troubleshoot an unguarded invocation
checkpoints.objective: Attach safe-output to the model invocation and clear the warning.
checkpoints.instruction: Review invocation logs, then attach the existing guardrail.
checkpoints.rationale: A correct policy has no effect until the invocation references it.
checkpoints.expectedOutcome: The invocation becomes guarded and logs record the correction.
hints: The guardrail exists, so inspect how it is attached.
Choose the corrective action that attaches the policy.

debrief.rootCause: The model invocation was not attached to the configured guardrail.
debrief.prevention: Validate both policy configuration and invocation attachment as observable semantic state.
debrief.explanation: The simulator validates resources and relationships, not labels clicked or navigation order. The same intent can later run against a managed sandbox provider.
